content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to use [product_name] [version_no] to send email notifications via Gmail or Yahoo Mail. I could not find any documentation concerning the required configuration. Can you share a practical example to follow? I believe others are interested in this too. Thanks.
Here’s a possible setup: SMTP server: smtp.gmail.com, connection security: STARTTLS, port: 587. Use your Gmail address as the login, and your password for authentication.
I’ve tried this configuration, but I keep getting a timeout error. Any advice?

I have the same challenge. I’ve attempted Gmail, Yahoo!, GMX, and Hotmail, but none worked. Even installing the CA certificate didn’t help. Each time I send a test email, I get either 'DNS Timeout' or 'DNS failure' messages. Any ideas for resolving this issue? Thanks.
When using GMX, my [product_name] [version_no] is able to send emails.
Good day! I’m sharing an image of the Hotmail configuration that worked for sending email through the [product_name] PLC [version_no]. I hope this is helpful. Have a great day.
Hello [user_name], please write your future posts in English, as that’s the preferred language here. Thanks.
Did you adjust any settings on your Hotmail account to allow sending emails via external services? My [product_name] is showing a login error.
Hello [user_name], please continue posting in English for this forum. Thanks.
Jecu, did you change anything in your email configuration? Please explain in more detail the steps you took.
Hello [user_name], English is required in this forum. Please write your messages in English. Thanks.

I have successfully used GMX with these settings: server: mail.gmx.net, connection security: STARTTLS, port: 587, login: your GMX credentials. You also need to install a CA certificate from your email provider (for GMX, in this case). Ensure both your computer and [product_name] have the correct date and time set for the certificate to work.
Can you clarify how and where you installed the CA certificate?

I have a similar SMTP problem. I created a GMX account and get partial progress but eventually a timeout occurs. Could you explain the process for finding and uploading the email provider’s certificate into the [product_name] SMTP settings?

analysis.insight_summary: Users frequently encounter configuration issues while trying to set up [product_name] [version_no] for email notifications using popular providers like Gmail, Yahoo!, GMX, and Hotmail. Timeout and authentication errors are common, with messages such as 'DNS Timeout,' 'DNS fail,' and login errors. While some have succeeded using GMX with certificate installation, many request clearer, more detailed instructions on third-party email setup. Documentation remains insufficient for these tasks.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and practical guidance for SMTP setup that allows [product_name] [version_no] to send emails via major providers effortlessly. They prefer not to perform elaborate configurations and want straightforward, reliable instructions.
